name: Silicon Valley Adult Education (San Jose)
description: Adult education including ESL, GED, high school diploma, and career training in San Jose
fullDescription: Silicon Valley Adult Education, run by the Metropolitan Education District (MetroED), provides classes for adults in San Jose including ESL, high school diploma, GED/HiSET, and career technical education.
whatTheyOffer:
- ESL (English) classes
- High school diploma program
- GED and HiSET preparation, plus a regional testing center
- Career and technical education courses
- College and career planning
howToGetIt:
1. Register online or visit the campus at 760 Hillsdale Avenue
2. Complete registration
3. Take placement assessment if required
4. Enroll in appropriate classes
5. Office hours: Monday-Thursday 8am-8:30pm, Friday 8am-4:30pm
keywords: adult school, San Jose, Santa Clara, GED, HiSET, ESL, high school diploma, adult education, career training, MetroED, SVAE, Silicon Valley Adult Education
